description: Check that this Space's decision record has not been rewritten. Pass a head and through_seq you saw earlier (space_state articles_chain): the server recomputes the hash chain over every Articles event up to that sequence and says whether it still matches. Without arguments it returns the current head. This catches a database edited behind the server's back. It cannot protect you from a server that lies: for that, recompute the chain yourself from read_articles (the recipe is in the result) and compare heads with another member through a channel UA does not control, since a dishonest server could show members different histories. Read-only, idempotent.

through_seq.description: The through_seq that head was reported with.

name: verify_articles
